secondFinding: the RSH-3 reference deck for GROW ASDAN carries no printable pack at all, while the family's frozen set includes shared.print.* and shared.confirmation.placement. A deck sliced from that donor cannot satisfy rows its own donor does not meet.
consequence: a new deck in either family cannot be proved green against g16, and the only ways to make one pass are to edit the contract rows or the denominators. Both are forbidden to make a PR pass, and reconciling a family's rows with its live decks is a ruling rather than an authoring decision.
